en: The Set of Twos Beginning with "Visible" (Sanidassanaduka), within the Set of Threes on the Wholesome (Kusalattika).

Dependent on a non-demonstrable wholesome state, a non-demonstrable unwholesome state arises by way of root condition... Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance. (The unwholesome is similar to the wholesome.
Dependent on a non-demonstrable indeterminate state, a non-demonstrable indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. One under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-reacting wholesome state, a non-reacting unwholesome state arises by way of root condition... Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-reactive unwholesome state, a non-reactive and non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition... Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Under the indeterminate [condition], there is one by way of condition. One under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
